text.tspan: FRAME — Verso. Curt performs the final manuscript build. Page 118 is still
ACTION — Source packets, corrections, and uncertainty labels compile beside
the reading edition. A cover proof reads THE TWO ANTHILL PROBLEM.
Beside it, a discarded connected-hills sketch remains visible under a heavy
cancellation stroke; the kept sketch has two separate surfaces and unmarked
space between. A revision slip reads 9 SEPTEMBER 2026 — TITLE
REVISION. Neither sketch has a queen, chamber, or individual agent identity.
Two tiny authored ants sit in the desk’s light; they do not stand for particular
DIALOGUE — CURT — “Two incidents. How many went unseen?”
SCREEN / SYSTEM TEXT — CHATGPT — “The picture cannot answer that.”
